label: Directly / indirectly / empirically…: DirectlyVerifiable F s: s is an observation statement, or…
definition: `DirectlyVerifiable F s`: s is an observation statement, or with one or more observation statements entails an observation statement not entailed by them alone. `IndirectlyVerifiable F s` (least predicate closed under the clause): with a nonempty list of further premises s entails a directly verifiable statement not entailed by those premises alone, each premise being analytic, directly verifiable or indirectly verifiable (`AdmissiblePremise`). `EmpiricallyVerifiable`: directly or indirectly verifiable.
note: Variant V3. Types Ayer's revised criterion as quoted verbatim in claim IEP-REL-LANG-2A-AYER-1946-CRITERION (LTL 2nd ed., Introduction, p. 13); the inductive reading of the recursion is the analyst's.
